## Cabinet component
- **Status:** Required
- **Type:** Factory Binding `Injects.ComponentsFactory` > `Injects.Cabinet`

### Description
The Cabinet component to sit at the bottom of the game screen for each core Tombola Arcade game.
Base functionality is defined in @arcade-client/cabinet-2.0 with a few abstract functions required to be defined by the game for unique behaviour.

Within super.init() it loads its core required assets itself so they don't need to be loaded manually but extra assets such as sound effects or additional Button textures will need to be loaded manually.

Standard implementation in the package but can be overriden by the game project. Should extend the abstract class `CabinetPackage` defined in @arcade-client/cabinet-2.0.

### API
#### initialise(): Promise<void>
Performs setup for the Cabinet including loading it's required assets into the AssetManager.

Called:
- after bindings
- after bootstrap
- after Vues are mounted
- after PIXI initilisation
- before gameApp.init

#### handleOrientationChange(): void
Required to be called in GameApplication. Intended to be called on every `GLOBAL.ORIENTATION_CHANGE` event.

#### onMenuButtonClick(): void 
Called when the cabinets menu button is clicked (typically shown with the burger menu icon).

Typically used to show the main menu with `container.frameConection.openMenu()`.

#### onActionButtonClick(): void
Called when the main cabinet button is clicked (also known as the buy button).

Typically Buys in to games but may also reveal symbols, start auto reveals, progress bonus rounds, etc...

#### onIncreaseStakeClick(): IStake
Called when the Stake + button is clicked. Returns the new stake value.

Typically Increases the stake, plays a sound effect and either disables itself or enables the Stake - button depend on the new stake value.

#### onDecreaseStakeClick(): IStake
Called when the Stake - button is clicked. Returns the new stake value.

Typically Decreases the stake, plays a sound effect and either disables itself or enables the Stake + button depend on the new stake value.

#### onGameInfoClick(): void
Called when the cabinets info button is clicked (typically shown with the trophy icon).

Typically opens a GameInfo panel or when held opens the Debug View

#### getStake(): IStake
Intended to return the current stake value as IStake.

Called in multiple places for to components to get that value when needed.

#### updateStakeButtons(): void
Internally called in Cabinet.reset();

Intended to update the interactiveness of the stake buttons dependant on the current stake value. Disabling the + at max stake or the - at min stake.
As well enabling + when lowering stake < max and enabling - when stake > min.

Typically called in `onIncreaseStakeClick()` and `onDecreaseStakeClick()` as well.

### BareBones Example
This is a super barebones example which doesn't implement any functionality typically seen in Tombola games but will compile out of the box.
```ts
// file Cabinet.ts

import { CabinetPackage, IStake, formatCurrency } from '@arcade-client/base-package';
import { container, userPreferences, device, environment } from '@arcade-client/base-package';

export class Cabinet extends CabinetPackage {
    constructor() {
        super(device, userPreferences);
    }

    public async initialise(): Promise<void> {
        await super.init(container.endPoints.urls[environment].cdnRoot);
    }

    public handleOrientationChange(): void {
        super.handleOrientationChange();
    }

    protected onMenuButtonClick(): void {
        container.frameConnection.openMenu();
    }

    protected onActionButtonClick(): void {
        console.warn('onActionButtonClick() called without implmentation');
    }

    protected onIncreaseStakeClick(): IStake {
        container.stake.increaseStake();
        return this.getStake();
    }

    protected onDecreaseStakeClick(): IStake {
        container.stake.decreaseStake();
        return this.getStake();
    }

    protected onGameInfoClick(): void {
        console.warn('onGameInfoClick() called without implmentation');
    }

    protected getStake(): IStake {
        const stakeAsPennies: number = container.stake.currentStake;

        return {
            stake: container.currencyFormatter.precise(stakeAsPennies),
            stakeAsPennies
        };
    }

    protected updateStakeButtons(): void {
        console.warn('updateStakeButtons() called without implmentation');
    }
}
```
